readings.moment: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen (thirteen minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock)
The temple struck eleven, and Lina stayed in the kitchen until after it struck
Madame's piano began (two minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock)
Madame's piano stopped (eleven minutes past eleven by the kitchen clock)
The hall clock struck eleven at the moment the kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven

durations: a quarter of an hour (the kitchen clock runs fast by this amount)
for years (the kitchen clock has been kept fast for this length of time)
thirteen minutes (the piano played from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock)
whereabouts: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen at about 10:47 by the kitchen clock.
Lina stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
Rosa was in the kitchen during Lina's visit, where she put the kettle on for Lina.
Rosa and Lina heard Madame's piano playing while they were together in the kitchen.
Madame was playing the piano from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock.
Rosa heard the hall clock strike eleven from the kitchen.
Rosa went up to the atelier to fetch Monsieur for the toast.
Rosa was on the stairs on the way to the atelier.
Monsieur was in the atelier, on the floor by his bench, dead.
Madame had said the glasses were ready and Monsieur must come down for the toast.
Rosa did not touch Monsieur's body.
Rosa was asked to wait in the hall after the interview.
